sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Uber API allows you to access rider profiles, trip history, and available products in a given area. This integration uses OAuth2 for secure user-level access.

sections.title: Prerequisites
sections.content: You need an Uber developer account. Register your application at developer.uber.com to obtain client credentials. Your app must be approved by Uber for production access.

sections.title: How to Connect
sections.content:
1. Sign in at developer.uber.com and create a new app.
2. Set the redirect URI to your OAuth callback URL.
3. Note your Client ID and Client Secret from the app dashboard.
4. Request the required OAuth scopes: profile, history, ride_widgets.
5. Click Connect and authorize with your Uber account credentials.

sections.title: Available Actions
sections.content:
get-profile: Retrieve the profile of the authenticated Uber user.
get-trip-history: Get a list of recent trips for the authenticated user.
list-products: List available Uber products (ride types) for a given location.
